text.en: Every lower group in classification is a part of the group above it.
A genus has more members than the class it sits in.

modelCorrection.en: A genus is a lower level inside a class, so it has fewer members, and they share more common features.

text.en: The species name alone, such as leo, is a full scientific name.

modelCorrection.en: A scientific name has two parts. The full name is Panthera leo.

text.en: A scientific name is written in italics when printed.
